note: ShelfCheck price system cleanup pass -- UPDATED after PR #29 (fix/runtime-census-determinism) merged to main. PR #29 replaced the racy census-mutation pipeline with a single deterministic finalization step; the correctly-finalized census is 2,532 INCLUDED, not the old 2,542 figure this file previously used (see PR #29's audit-out/runtime-census-determinism.json for the full root-cause/fix). This pass rebased feature/price-system-cleanup onto current main and regenerated every number below from the live, finalized 2,532-identity runtime -- none of it is hardcoded. Prior 2,542-based numbers (2,053 priced / 489 pending / 80.76%) are obsolete and superseded by the figures in this file.

runtimeBaselineUpdate.reason: PR #29 fixed a real script-ordering race in census-cleanup.js/census-collapse-v035.js (their general EXCLUDE/COLLAPSE maps sat earlier in index.html than the census-v052..059 PriceCharting sweep that adds new identities, so whether an added identity matching an existing exclusion rule got correctly re-excluded depended on timing). The new deterministic pipeline (registerCensusMutation -> census-finalize.js, add phase always before exclude phase) makes every existing exclusion rule apply consistently. Result: 10 identities that could sometimes slip through as INCLUDED under the old race are now always EXCLUDED -- all 10 already matched an existing, already-authored exclusion/dedup rule (digital-only or no confirmed physical release); none is a new eligibility opinion, and none was added/removed by this price pass.

None was baseline:'OWNED', so the OWNED breakdown (230/211/19) is completely unchanged by this update.

Cross-checked against a live browser session: DATA.n === 2532 after load, matching this tool's output exactly.

priceSortBug.cause: model-fix.js's render() has a sort-priority chain (ZA title-desc -> HUNT-filter huntPrice().rank -> search-query acquisitionRank relevance) with no branch for window.SHELFCHECK_SORT==='LOW'/'HIGH'. Whenever a search query was present, model-fix's render unconditionally re-sorted by acquisitionRank + alphabetical tie-break, discarding the price ordering that price-sort-v063.js's outer render wrapper had already applied to the `items` array -- this is what actually produced the 'looks alphabetized' symptom. Plain ALL/OWNED/NEEDED views with an EMPTY search box were not affected.
priceSortBug.fix: Exposed price-sort-v063.js's existing numeric comparator as window.SHELFCHECK_PRICE_COMPARE, and added one branch to model-fix.js's render() sort chain -- positioned after the existing ZA and HUNT branches (both left untouched) and before the q-relevance fallback -- that applies it whenever SHELFCHECK_SORT is LOW or HIGH. HUNT's own price-hierarchy ranking is unchanged by design.
priceSortBug.validationStatus: PASS -- re-verified live in a clean browser session AFTER rebasing onto main/PR #29, against the corrected 2,532-identity finalized census: full ALL/OWNED/NEEDED/HUNT x LOW/HIGH x empty/non-empty-search matrix (16 combinations), all numerically monotonic with unknown ('PRICE PENDING') prices last and alphabetical tie-break intact. (The unrelated 'BEST WAY TO BUY' collection-recommendation cards that fun-features-v103.js injects for some search queries were excluded from this check -- they are pre-existing, out-of-scope functionality with their own 'games added' ordering, not part of the price sort.)
